title: Q-CIFAIL-mergeaudit-2222: PR #2222 merged without a green checks run
body:
**Owner:** staff
**Trigger:** every lane pass
**Done check:** cmd:python3 -m foundation mergeaudit --probe 2222
**Status:** closed

MERGE-AUDIT-1: PR #2222 (Make the white papers and every fleet property findable) merged at 2026-11-25T20:01:47Z with its `checks` run at `failure` on head a152b16. Some merge path skipped the green gate.

Fix what that run caught on main (run the failed step from .github/workflows/checks.yml locally), then confirm a later merged PR passed `checks`. Do not weaken a check.

**Vacuous:** 2026-11-25T20:21:44Z vacuous: the probe was never recorded failing on this item, so its pass cannot show the defect is gone; rewrite the probe so it fails while the defect exists

**Disposition:** fixed (executor-failed, 2026-11-25T20:53:39Z, DISPOSE-1)

**Evidence:** the executor failed 3 consecutive runs on this item; last reason: RuntimeError: checks failed after 3 attempts: the reply was not valid JSON with a files list: RuntimeError: every code agent rung failed: workers-ai-glm: HTTPError: HTTP Error 401: Unauthorized | github-models-gpt: RuntimeError: non-JSON re. Its closing probe still runs on every fleet pass and records `fixed` when it passes; the executor retries it when its open queue is empty (every 30 days at most).

**Evidence:** 2026-11-26T16:18:28Z closing probe passed after the item was disposed: green since
